title: Extension.
officialText:
Wall signs shall not extend above the top of the wall, nor beyond the ends of the wall to which the signs are
attached unless such signs conform to the requirements for roof signs, projecting signs or ground signs.
SECTION BC H112
PROJECTING SIGNS
